title: Telemetry Log Hotspots
description: A smart factory monitors thousands of IoT sensor logs per minute. Each log entry produces an integer sensor ID indicating an event. To optimize maintenance schedules, engineers need to identify the top k most frequently triggered sensor IDs. Given an integer array sensor_ids and an integer k, return the k most frequent sensor IDs. You may return the answer in any order. The solution must run in better than O(n log n) time complexity.
constraints: 1 <= k <= number of unique elements in sensor_ids
It is guaranteed that the answer is unique for the given input.
input_format: The first argument is an integer array sensor_ids. The second argument is an integer k.
output_format: Return an array of k integers representing the most frequent sensor IDs.

examples.explanation: Sensor ID 101 appears 3 times, ID 202 appears 2 times, and ID 303 appears 1 time. The top 2 most frequent IDs are 101 and 202.
Sensor ID 42 is the only ID present and appears 1 time.
Sensor ID 8 appears 4 times, ID 9 appears 3 times, and ID 7 appears 2 times. The top 2 IDs are 8 and 9.
